agents.name: Planner
agents.calls: states the questions this run must establish

agents.name: Critic
agents.calls: exculpatory.evaluate — attempts to DISPROVE each hypothesis

agents.name: Verifier
agents.calls: verification.ground_claim — re-resolves and re-hashes cited records

note: Eight stages. The critic runs after the analyst so it has hypotheses to attack, and the responder runs after the critic so it never proposes acting on a lead already explained away. The LLM writes prose only — scoring, resolution, refutation and every decision are deterministic, and no action is executed without human authorization. No cloud LLM API is used unless an operator explicitly enables one (LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic).
